title: Workspace create validators are listed in the two workspace USE tests
answers: where to add tests for a new workspace create validator
how workspace USE grants are tested for create routes
which test checks resource-type USE does not allow creates
body:
Convention: each workspace create validator (validate_can_create_experiment, validate_can_create_registered_model, validate_can_create_gateway_secret, and similar) is asserted in both role-based and resource-type tests in tests/server/auth/test_auth_workspace.py.
Positive assertions go in test_role_grant_workspace_use_allows_create; negative assertions go in test_role_grant_resource_type_use_does_not_allow_create.
A no-permission check for the new validator belongs in test_no_permissions_blocks_create, with a dedicated grant/revoke test as in test_gateway_secret_create_requires_workspace_create_grant.
When adding a create validator, add it to all of these; the coverage test alone does not check the workspace USE behavior.
applies: Tests for any new create validator that depends on workspace permission in basic-auth.
says: Users with workspace access permissions are unable to create new experiments or models.
Resource permissions should not allow unauthorized users to create assets inside a workspace.
Ensure adding new secrets or experiments requires explicit workspace creation rights.
Users without granted workspace permissions are still able to add new gateway secrets.
